title: S.U.V. Driver Charged With Murder in Los Angeles Bus Crash
summary: Prosecutors said the driver was impaired by drugs and ran a red light before ramming a city bus on Tuesday. Two people died. Compounding the tragedy, a news helicopter also crashed.
